name: boltarr
description: Boltarr is a self-hosted network dashboard for mapping, monitoring, and analyzing your local network. Scan subnets with nmap, visualize your topology as an interactive graph, track devices, manage VLANs, and chat with an optional AI assistant that has full context of your network. AI is optional — works without it. Supports Ollama, OpenAI-compatible APIs, and Anthropic.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Persistent storage for the database (boltarr.db) and AI config (config.yaml).

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Port Boltarr listens on. Access the UI at http://[server-ip]:[port]/

variables.name: AI Provider
variables.description: AI provider to use. Leave blank to configure via the UI instead. Options: none | ollama | openai | anthropic

variables.name: AI Base URL
variables.description: Base URL for the AI API. Required for Ollama and OpenAI-compatible providers. Example: http://192.168.1.10:11434

variables.name: AI Model
variables.description: Default model to use. Example: llama3.2, gpt-4o, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001

variables.name: AI API Key
variables.description: API key for OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic providers. Not needed for Ollama.

variables.name: AI Timeout (seconds)
variables.description: Timeout in seconds for standard AI requests.

variables.name: AI Long Timeout (seconds)
variables.description: Timeout in seconds for long-running AI requests (e.g. full network analysis).
